question.text: For IDCW distributions to resident investors with PAN, what is the TDS threshold below which no tax is deducted?

answer.text: Rs.5,000 per year per fund house
Rs.10,000 per year per fund house
No threshold — TDS applies on all IDCW

explanation.text: The Logic: No TDS is deducted on dividend income in respect of units of a mutual fund if the amount does not exceed Rs.5,000 in a financial year. The Trap: The Rs.5,000 figure is a TDS threshold and not an exemption from tax — IDCW remains taxable in the investor's hands even when below this limit. Note: Confirm PAN is on the folio; the Rs.5,000 threshold applies only when PAN is available and the investor is a resident.
